attrs.prompt: Vertical-leaning editorial illustration for a relationships blog section about building a slow-burn over text. Minimalist flat-design layout with a warm, playful, low-pressure mood. Canvas is 3:2 landscape on a clean warm off-white background (hex #FAF7F4) with a barely-there soft paper grain. Composition map - a single stylized smartphone stands upright and centered, occupying roughly 40 percent of the frame width, its screen showing a vertical stack of four chat message bubbles ascending from bottom to top, and a thin upward-curving dotted line runs up the right side of the phone suggesting rising warmth. Per-element specification - the phone is a clean flat-vector device with a soft slate-blue body (hex #4A5568) and rounded corners, a simple status bar with abstract dots and no readable numbers. Inside the screen, four chat bubbles climb in a deepening dusty-rose tint to signal escalation - the lowest bubble is pale blush (hex #F4D9DD) reading the short string Hey, the next a touch deeper (hex #ECB8C0) reading Thinking about you, the next deeper still (hex #DD8E9B) reading Wait till later, and the top bubble the most saturated rose (hex #C9697A) showing only three small heart-dot glyphs and no words. Each bubble is a rounded speech shape with a small tail. Character and emotion - no people, no faces, no hands, purely an abstract device-and-bubbles diagram whose feeling is flirtatious anticipation building one step at a time, friendly and tasteful, never explicit. Style triangulation - modern flat editorial infographic, clean Scandinavian vector design meets a tasteful wellness-brand illustration, NOT skeuomorphic, NOT 3D, NOT photoreal, NOT anime, no glossy gradients beyond the deliberate bubble-tint progression. Lighting and render spec - flat even lighting with one subtle soft contact shadow beneath the phone as if gently grounded, crisp clean edges. Palette block - background off-white #FAF7F4, phone slate #4A5568, bubbles graduated dusty rose #F4D9DD through #ECB8C0 and #DD8E9B to #C9697A, any glyphs in dark slate #2D3748. Typography block - clean geometric sans-serif like Inter or Poppins, sentence case, only these exact short strings appear in the image - Hey, Thinking about you, Wait till later - and no other text, no numbers, no watermark. Mood line and quality anchor - warm, playful, encouraging, tasteful, premium editorial, Awwwards / Behance site-of-the-day quality, 4k.
